metadata.architectural_response: A broad curved subtraction creates a through passage beneath one inhabited spanning body. The opening has an arched upper boundary and the side masses remain grounded; the actual support span still requires engineering.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: Programme, doors, stairs, accessible roof routes, structural member capacity and parking operation remain to be designed and independently verified.
